besluite.fout: The doubled 'en ... en' in a plain three-item list reads clumsily.
besluite.rede: A comma list is the natural Afrikaans form here, and the list keeps the same three materials.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: 'Die raam hou' and 'die bedekking hou' are two full clauses, so the AWS 2017 comma before 'en' is required.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'n Kragmas is' and 'sy stutte is' each have their own subject and verb.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Die tak bly' and 'hy dra' are two full clauses joined by 'en'.

besluite.fout: 'lank in 'n gemeenskap se hande is' is a wooden, unclear image in the sentence that defines 'tradisioneel'.
besluite.rede: The fault is real, but this sentence defines a term and 'gebruik word' narrows the sense from a practice the community holds and passes on to one it merely uses, so the writer should fix it.
'Iets vir iemand wys' is natural, accepted Afrikaans with the same meaning, so the swap is lateral.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Ouers wys' and 'so gaan dit ... aan' each have their own subject and verb.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'n Zoeloe-grashuis is rond' and 'die hele huis buig' are two full clauses.

besluite.fout: 'Sy raam is jong takke' is an awkward equation of a frame with its material.
besluite.rede: 'bestaan uit' is the natural Afrikaans way to say what a frame is made of, with no change in meaning.

besluite.fout: 'van die muur af op na een punt bo' piles up direction words and makes a reader stumble.
besluite.rede: The proposal says the same thing plainly: the poles slope up from the wall and meet at one point at the top.
'stut die dak van onder' is already natural and clear, so adding 'af' is a lateral move.
'tot op die grond kom' is natural Afrikaans and plainer for a Grade 4 reader than 'strek'.
'hulle eie taal' is a fixed expression that stresses the contrast with the Afrikaans name and matches the glossary entry, so dropping 'eie' loses emphasis for little gain.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Hulle word vasgebind' and 'die raam word ... gedek' each have their own subject and verb.

besluite.fout: 'aangegee' suggests handing over an object, whereas a tradition is normally 'oorgedra'.
besluite.rede: This rewords a glossary definition beyond a spelling or grammar fix, so only the writer may change it, for every lesson that uses it.
